title: treaty MCP tool catalog
description: The tools one MCP server offers: each tool's name, the scope a caller needs for it to be offered, its input schema and the shape of what it returns. A catalog lives at schemas/mcp/<server>.v<N>.json and its cases at fixtures/mcp/<server>.v<N>.cases.json. A business failure stays a tool result with `isError: true`, as MCP defines it; `error` names what that result carries. Readers ignore properties they do not know: an input schema without `additionalProperties: false` accepts arguments it does not name.

name.description: The name the server reports in `initialize` (serverInfo.name).

path.description: The HTTP path the server answers on, for a Streamable HTTP server.

error.description: What a tool result with `isError: true` carries, for every tool.

$defs.description: Schemas the tools' result schemas share, referenced as `#/$defs/<name>`.

scope.description: The token scope a caller needs for the server to offer the tool, or null when every authenticated caller is offered it.

description.description: The description the server sends in `tools/list`.

inputSchema.description: The JSON Schema the tool's arguments satisfy, as `tools/list` sends it, read as draft 2020-12.

annotations.description: The tool's MCP annotations, as `tools/list` sends them.

carrier.description: text-json: the result's first `text` content item holds a JSON document. structured: the result's `structuredContent` holds it.

schema.description: The JSON Schema the carried document satisfies. A `$ref` resolves against the catalog, so `#/$defs/<name>` reaches the catalog's shared schemas.
